title: Model & Route Latency Sparklines — p50/p95/p99 + streaming/non-streaming split
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a consolidated Grafana dashboard and supporting metric/log/tracing pipeline changes to surface fine-grained latency SLOs per model and per route. The dashboard will show p50/p95/p99 sparklines and percentile deltas for both streaming and non-streaming request paths, with the ability to filter by model, route tags (canary/production), region, and quantization profile. We will also add a lightweight trace hook at request ingress to attach route/model metadata and kernel annotations so traces can be correlated with aggregated percentiles. This ticket covers schema changes to metrics, dashboard panels, query templates, and an implementation plan for low-cost high-resolution percentile storage and backfill for the last 90 days.
acceptance_criteria: Grafana dashboard deployed to staging with panels for p50/p95/p99 sparklines at 5m resolution
Panels show side-by-side streaming vs non-streaming breakdown and support model+route filtering
Trace hook implements route+model tags and kernel-latency spans for 100% ingress sampling metadata (traces sampled separately)
Metrics ingestion pipeline updated to emit percentile-ready histograms (Prometheus/Pushgateway -> ClickHouse rollups) and documented
Backfill script created to populate new rollup tables for the past 90 days without impacting production ingestion
CSV export and dashboard-permalink functionality working for support runbooks
Unit and integration tests for the trace hook and metrics producer merged and reviewed
